correctness.rationale: Pauli coordinates identify rank-one positive semidefinite matrices with the future null cone. For a rank-three measurement operator, equality of measurements means that two cone points differ by a real multiple of the unique Hermitian kernel generator. The exact line--cone equation has second-root time coordinate with sign opposite to the sign of the determinant. This proves global uniqueness for positive determinant, one null exceptional ray for zero determinant, and generic two-point fibers for negative determinant. If measurement rank is below three, the sharp complex PR-ae lower bound rules out PR-ae.

evidence: Wang--Xu Theorem 2.2 says full PR holds when every nonzero Hermitian rank-at-most-two kernel element has its two nonzero eigenvalues of the same sign. With a one-dimensional kernel in dimension two, this is exactly the positive-determinant branch.

Huang--Rong--Wang--Xu prove that three measurements are necessary and attainable for PR-ae in complex dimension two, but their inspected minimal construction does not imply that every zero-determinant kernel is PR-ae or that every negative-determinant kernel has generic two-point fibers.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Prior work implies only part of the final trichotomy. The zero-determinant and negative-determinant branches require the explicit line--cone intersection analysis, so the full final claim is not subsumed by the cited broader results.

originality.rationale: The sharp three-measurement existence and lower bound are prior. The full-PR positive-determinant branch is also a specialization of the known Wang--Xu kernel criterion. The additional statement classified here is the exact almost-everywhere boundary for every rank-three triple, including the zero-determinant exceptional line and the negative-determinant generic two-to-one regime. The inspected primary and later sources do not state this trichotomy.
residual_risks: The determinant-sign trichotomy is elementary once the Pauli/Lorentz representation is chosen, so an unindexed low-dimensional note or quantum-tomography source may contain an equivalent observation under different terminology.
The quantum-tomography literature is broad; only the most directly suggested pure-state informational-completeness alias was inspected in this run.

value.rationale: Three measurements are the sharp minimum for complex almost-everywhere generalized phase retrieval in dimension two. The theorem completely classifies every triple at that minimum, distinguishes full PR from PR-ae at the semidefinite boundary, and gives exact generic fiber multiplicity in the indefinite regime. This is a natural structural completion of the minimal-measurement result rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
